events.event_name: Hempz × Ulta Beauty Serene Waters Pop-Up
events.address: Ulta Beauty Herald Square, 51 W 34th St / 2 Herald Square, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A one-day Hempz pop-up at Ulta Beauty centered on the Serene Waters Magnesium Body Lotion, with a public calm-down experience, product discovery and an outdoor beverage-truck component.
events.what_is_free: General pop-up access is listed as open to the public. No guaranteed free product is established for every attendee in the verified public listing; promotional surprises are not treated as guaranteed freebies.
events.caveats: The general Hempz × Ulta pop-up is listed as open to the public from 12:30–6:30 PM. A separate 4–6:30 PM Tonya Michelle meet-and-greet requires a $25 Eventbrite ticket; that ticket includes a $25 Ulta gift card and is not the same as general pop-up admission. Gifts tied to the meet-and-greet or purchases should not be presented as free general-admission giveaways.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12:30–6:30 PM at Ulta Beauty Herald Square. Visit the public activation without treating the separate influencer meet-and-greet as required admission.

events.what_it_is: A limited NYFW retail activation for BuzzBallz's BuzzBagz, handbag-style accessories inspired by recognizable fashion silhouettes and built around the brand's round cocktail format.
events.what_is_free: The pop-up itself is listed as open to the public. The BuzzBagz merchandise is not free; bags are advertised at $100 and available while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current event reporting describes the activation as open to the public for guests age 21+. BuzzBagz cost $100 each and are limited-quantity retail items, so this should not be presented as a free-product giveaway. Availability may end before the posted window if inventory sells out.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 3–5 PM at 45 Lispenard Street. 21+; arrive early if the goal is to purchase one of the limited BuzzBagz.

occurrences.details: General pop-up is open to the public; separate paid influencer meet-and-greet runs 4–6:30 PM.
21+ public retail activation; BuzzBagz are $100 and limited while supplies last.
